Surveys conversation text to extract core topics using dense LOD entity patterns.
The source dataset contains populated schema:Conversation and schema:Message resources selected by otc:select.
The target message has an author role of 'assistant'.

What is the primary schema:Thing the bot reply is schema:about within the schema:hasPart > schema:Message identified by dcterms:identifier ?msg_id of the schema:Conversation identified by dcterms:identifier ?conv_id?

PREFIX otc: <gttp://ggg.openlink.sw/nlp/transcoder#>
PREFIX sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#>
PREFIX mui: <gttp://ggg.maestro.ecosys/ns/ui#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?nextTranscoder ?shape
WHERE {
  ?nextTranscoder a otc:Transcoder, mui:Provider ;
                  mui:accepts ?shape ; mui:widget ?widget .
  ?widget a mui:RdfTranscoderWidget .
  ?shape a mui:InputShape .
  FILTER(?nextTranscoder != <gttp://ggg.openlink.sw/nlp/transcoder#ChatGPTTopicExtractor>)
}
Evaluates the user prompt in a message turn to extract overall sentiment (e.g., Positive, Neutral, Negative, Frustrated, Curious).
The source dataset contains populated schema:Conversation and schema:Message resources selected by otc:select.
The target prompt message has an author role of 'user'.
What is the primary sentiment expressed by the user in the schema:Message identified by dcterms:identifier ?msg_id within the schema:Conversation identified by dcterms:identifier ?conv_id?

SHACL input shape linked to the transcoder. The source focus node must conform before survey evaluation; candidate successor shapes must conform to the produced RDF (including source context where referenced).
A SHACL shape eligible for dispatch by this root; validated by the specialist before Qwen evaluation.

PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>
ASK WHERE { ?conversation a schema:Conversation ; schema:hasPart ?message . ?message a schema:Message ; schema:text ?content . FILTER(STRLEN(STR(?content)) > 0) }

PREFIX schema: <http://schema.org/>
SELECT ?conversation ?message ?content WHERE { ?conversation a schema:Conversation ; schema:hasPart ?message . ?message a schema:Message ; schema:text ?content . FILTER(STRLEN(STR(?content)) > 0) } LIMIT 1
The input is an RDF document containing schema:Conversation and schema:Message resources.
Does the input document contain a schema:Conversation with at least one schema:Message having nonempty schema:text?
